plan_rewrites: RewriteConfig.gate_epilogue = on  (on: rule 12's memory rescue turned it off, and recompute_node_region (turned on after it) keeps its extra memory within its chunks, so it is on again and the estimate still fits (docs/validation/region-norm.md))
RewriteConfig.recompute_conv_weights = on  (on by rule 12: the estimate does not fit 90% of the free GPU memory without it; turning recompute_conv_weights on saves about 21056 MiB (CAP-T07, CAP-T08))

RewriteConfig.recompute_first_table = on  (on by rule 12: the estimate does not fit 90% of the free GPU memory without it, with recompute_conv_weights on; turning recompute_first_table on saves about 1168 MiB (CAP-T07, CAP-T08))

RewriteConfig.recompute_node_segments = on  (on by rule 12: the estimate does not fit 90% of the free GPU memory without it, with recompute_conv_weights on, recompute_first_table on; turning recompute_node_segments on saves about 8993 MiB (CAP-T07, CAP-T08))

RewriteConfig.recompute_node_region = on  (on by rule 12: the estimate does not fit 90% of the free GPU memory without it, with recompute_conv_weights on, recompute_first_table on, recompute_node_segments on, gate_epilogue off; turning recompute_node_region on saves about 6968 MiB (CAP-T07, CAP-T08))
